in_arabic.name: جويرية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من جوار ومعناه الصغيرة أو البنت الصغيرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جويرية هو اسم مؤنث مشتق من كلمة جوار، ومعناه الصغيرة أو البنت الصغيرة. وقد ورد ذكر هذا الاسم في السنة النبوية المطهرة، حيث كانت جويرية بنت الحارثة زوجة للنبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء ذات المعنى الجميل والدلالة العميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: جویریہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز نام، جو چھوٹی یا کمسن لڑکی کے معنی میں ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: جویریہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے शब्द 'جوار' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں چھوٹی یا کمسن لڑکی۔ یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں اہم مقام رکھتا ہے کیونکہ جويرية بنت الحارثة رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی زوجہ تھیں۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان خاص طور پر مقبول ہے اور اس کا انتخاب اس کی خوبصورتی اور گہرے معانی کی وجہ سے کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_pashto.meaning: د يوې کوچنۍ يا کم عمره انجلۍ نوم

in_english.name: Juwairiyah
in_english.meaning: A beautiful name meaning little or young girl
in_english.long_meaning: Juwairiyah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic word 'Jawar', meaning little or young girl. This name holds significant historical and spiritual importance in Islamic tradition as it was the name of Juwairiyah bint al-Haritha, one of the wives of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name is popular across Muslim cultures for its beauty and profound meaning, symbolizing innocence and youth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Juwairiyah holds significant cultural significance in Islamic history as it is the name of one of the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) wives. Juwairiyah bint Al-Harith was a young and beautiful woman who was given as a gift to the Prophet (PBUH) by her father, Al-Harith bin Hisham Al-Taghlibi, in exchange for his help in defeating the Banu Qurayza tribe. The story of Juwairiyah's marriage to the Prophet (PBUH) is a fascinating example of the social and political alliances that were common during that time. It also highlights the importance of generosity and the giving of gifts as a sign of respect and loyalty.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Juwairiyah can be seen as a reminder of the infinite compassion and mercy of Allah (SWT). The fact that the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) married Juwairiyah despite her being a gift from an enemy shows his unwavering commitment to the principles of forgiveness and compassion. It is a powerful reminder of the capacity for transformation and redemption, and of the importance of treating all people with kindness and respect. Additionally, the name Juwairiyah can be seen as a reflection of the reality that even the most beautiful and valuable things in life are ultimately small and compact in comparison to the infinite and boundless nature of Allah (SWT).
